sloka: यथा पूर्वम् गजः स्नात्वा गृह्य हस्तेन वै रजः ।दूषयत्यात्मनो देहम् तथानार्येषु सौहृदम् ॥६-१६-१५॥।।
transliteration: yathā pūrvam gajaḥ snātvā gṛhya hastena vai rajaḥ ।dūṣayatyātmano deham tathānāryeṣu sauhṛdam ॥6-16-15॥।।

translations.english: "Just as honeybees do not stay at the flower after satisfaction with the nectar, in the same way is the friendship with unworthy ones."
